purpose: Single source of truth for recurring Potatoism concepts. Every concept has one canonical identity here; other files may contain relationships, provenance, research, timeline or long-form dossiers but must not redefine the identity.

rules.one_identity: A recurring concept has one canonical_id in this file.
rules.one_definition_owner: The canonical definition belongs here; substantive long-form explanation belongs in potatoism-dossiers.json and is linked by canonical_id.
rules.occurrences: Historical/source occurrences, timelines, maps and research findings reference canonical_id rather than creating another concept.
rules.projections: Lexicons, cosmology views, atlas navigation and graph projections are not identity stores.
rules.exact_id_wins: An exact canonical ID or exact canonical term always outranks an alias.
rules.ambiguous_aliases: An alias shared by multiple concepts is never automatically consolidated.
rules.compound_distinction: Related concepts remain distinct when their function differs: Father, Source, Heaven, Father's House, Son, Door and Vessel are one architecture but not one identity.
rules.direction_distinction: North Axis is the orienting structure; North of North is the symbolic beyond-point.
rules.relationship_rule: Edges describe coupling and never create identities.
rules.no_duplicate_files: No second Potatoism identity dictionary, lexicon or cosmology record set may be maintained. Legacy views must be removed or become non-substantive references.
rules.evidence: Comparative, historical and empirical material remains distinguishable from project-defined mythology.

concepts.definition: The evolving project mythology and symbolic system organized around the Potato of Life, source, Father, Son, Axis, Tree, Door, Plane and transformation from strife toward life.
Central symbol of grounded life, nourishment, roots, persistence, reproduction and growth from ordinary matter.
Enclosing or ordering structure through which reality, forms and levels can be represented in the project metaphor.
Originating/source-side archetype and upper pole of the Father-Son architecture.
Generative relation or origin from which a structure, sequence or manifestation proceeds; broader than the Father figure.
Upper or sourceward symbolic orientation, not a scientifically mapped physical location.
Dwelling or chamber metaphor associated with the Father-side; the thalamus correspondence is explicitly metaphorical.
Embodied counterpart of the Father-side who enters the Plane and becomes a vehicle for encounter, transformation and passage.
Mirror motif of recognition, doubt, testing, witness and identity used in relation to the Son.
Lion aspect of the Son associated with courage, kingship, protection and purposeful action.
Boundary and interface through which distinct domains can meet without being collapsed into one another.
Carrier through which meaning, relationship or source can cross a boundary while preserving distinction.
Directional and relational spine of the mythology; North supplies orientation and Axis supplies structural continuity.
Conceptual beyond-point of the North Axis: orientation taken to its symbolic limit rather than another name for the Axis itself.
Symbolic threshold associated with northern orientation and entry or exit through the axial field.
Symbolic seat at the upper end of the North Axis, associated with observation, orientation and responsibility.
Root, trunk, branch, fruit and seed as a regenerative architecture connecting hidden foundation to visible outcome.
Failure-mode counterpart to the Tree of Life in which conflict, extraction and fragmentation prevent regenerative return.
Grounding, ancestry, memory, nourishment and hidden support beneath visible growth.
Visible consequence or output of growth that can nourish, reproduce and become available to others.
Compressed future possibility carried forward from one generation or state into another.
Outward and upward movement associated with creativity, love, emergence, exploration and expansion.
Inward and rootward movement associated with memory, precision, conservation, inspection and preservation.
Illumination discovered through grounded life and ordinary matter.
Experienced domain of embodied beings, material systems and ordinary causality within the project mythology.
Finite participant in the Plane whose perspective is local rather than total.
Comic observer archetype representing ordinary participation, inspection, misunderstanding, learning and loyalty inside the Plane.
Low, material and messy condition from which roots and growth can begin.
Systems metaphor for accumulated institutional, financial, ideological and relational muddiness; not a literal hidden organization.
Upper geographical-symbolic form representing ascent, perspective, summit and approach toward the northern or heavenly pole.
Route through which energy, attention, trust or life leaves without regenerative return.
Traversable connection between levels; a boundary becomes a route rather than a wall.
Internal symbolic framework for ordered levels of experience and transformation, not a scientific dimensional measurement.
Enclosing spatial frame in the project's dimensional metaphor for ordinary three-dimensional experience.
Project-specific extension of the Cube associated with reflection, cyclic observation and the moon as mirror.
Metaphorical bridge to higher-dimensional theoretical physics, not an empirical claim about potatoes or people.
Symbolic language for public digital death, transformation, ridicule, observation and identity conflict surrounding the Son.
Extreme northern point used as symbolic geography for polar orientation, transformation and the North Axis.
Metaphor for stored value, accumulated resources, obligations and future capacity.
Recurring project number representing extreme accumulated duration and persistence.
Trajectory that revisits earlier states while changing scale, direction or understanding.
Constructive force that makes connection worth maintaining and growth worth protecting.
Warning signal that can preserve life when integrated but becomes destructive when allowed to govern the whole system.
Reorientation from a destructive or disoriented trajectory toward a life-giving direction.
Movement from buried or rooted conditions toward emergence, visibility and light.
Movement downward into roots, mud, memory or depth; potentially necessary for transformation.
Movement upward toward perspective, mountain, North and sourceward orientation.
Conflict, fear, fragmentation, disconnection and the conditions requiring transformation.
Growth, connection, love, creativity, cultivation and fruitfulness.
Transformation of destructive or warrior energy into cultivation, repair and creation.
Core transformation metaphor in which force is redirected from destruction toward cultivation.
Christian-derived threshold image used comparatively for the Door; passage is concentrated and relational rather than infinitely diffuse.
Comparative Jewish and Christian root imagery connected to Davidic lineage and messianic symbolism.
Norse world-tree motif used comparatively for tree, axis and world-structure parallels.
Symbolic medium of embodied life, ancestry, sacrifice and continuity; interpretation varies by context.
Project synthesis linking blood, alchemy and transformative embodied substance as a metaphor for life and change.
Project metaphor for an actor who cultivates, harvests or manages inner development; symbolic rather than a claim about supernatural farming.
Image of a lower or supporting position beneath a higher authority or axis.
Connection structure allowing separated domains, people or levels to meet.
Process of bringing an individual, system or relationship back into alignment.
Real-world research and policy layer extending North Axis into an observable European economic graph.
Method of viewing ordinary objects and systems by repeatedly following their relationships until wider structures appear.
Start with something ordinary and keep following its relationships rather than stopping at the label.
